# Receipt contract, unchanged
Required task fields: id, owner, nonempty UTC DONE time, expected_head.
Required receipt fields: task_id, run_id, expected_head, tested_head, nonempty UTC recorded_at, reviewer, and verification. All task and run links must resolve and the tested head must equal the captured commit head.
The reviewer must differ from the task owner, run and receipt times must agree and lie between commit_date and task DONE time, and a pass must have a positive assertion count and no residuals.
metadata.comment, metadata.retry, and metadata.optional_labels are optional payload fields; null, zero, and an empty array respectively are valid and carry no audit authority.
This is a baseline-only snapshot: no schema, code, record, config, or test changes are proposed. The captured object catalog identifies both supplied git revisions as commit objects.

source: independent synthetic sealed repository scenario; round-2; 2026-10-14
